name: standard-parts-and-owner-label
description: A standard of four parts whose second and fourth parts are the same passage (OPF-SPEC §3.5, §3.5.6, §3.12.2, §3.12.3, issue #243). The fourth part's part_id is the second's content hash with -2 appended, and the digest's our_standard carries all four parts in order. Every part map has one token per part, in standard order. Deal-a opened with our standard and signed a mixed variant (=, x0, -, = plus a more protective addition): a concession, the first signed variant, and the dossier's first excerpt, whose part_reasons name only the third part. Deal-b signed a variant that drops both copies of the repeated passage as neutral omissions: still equivalent, so it collapses (n_texts 1). Deal-c's refused ask keeps the first part, drops the rest (the third less protective) and adds a less protective sentence: less_protective. Deal-d opened with language whose parts derive mixed (-, x+, =, +) but the owner set the label to more_protective with a reason (owner_label): its changed opening in the digest carries label more_protective, label_by owner and the owner's reason, never the judgment's own reason, with the part map as judged; every other judged entry carries no label_by (its label is derived from its parts, the default the legend states) and the judgment's reason. The dossier's second excerpt is that changed opening, with label_by owner, the owner's reason and part reasons for the first, second and fourth (repeated, -2) parts.

part_map.=: our part is present with the same legal effect
part_map.+: our part is present but more protective for perspective.party
part_map.-: our part is present but less protective for perspective.party
part_map.x+: our part is omitted, which is more protective for perspective.party
part_map.x-: our part is omitted, which is less protective for perspective.party
part_map.x0: our part is omitted with no effect on perspective.party

additions.+: an addition no part covers, more protective for perspective.party
additions.-: an addition no part covers, less protective for perspective.party
additions.0: an addition no part covers, neutral for perspective.party

label_by.parts: the default, so a digest entry omits label_by: the label is derived from the part map and additions; reason is the judgment's most important difference
label_by.owner: the owner set the label over the judged part map and additions, which may imply another label; reason is the owner's and wins

settled.agreed: an independent blind check reached the same label and parts as the judgment
settled.adjudicated: the blind check disagreed and a fresh agent decided: the judgment shown is that decision, so this label was contested and deserves more scrutiny
settled.unchecked: no completed blind check (none yet, or a disagreement still awaiting adjudication): weaker evidence than agreed or adjudicated
settled.owner: the owner set or corrected the judgment; it is never blind-checked
